purpose: Planning inventory for measuring how the current command, script-block, and cloud-action index can assist retrieval of sealed benchmark evidence atoms. This file contains no benchmark answer values or match literals.
title_semantics: Atom titles are evaluator-safe summaries. They are intentionally not guaranteed to reproduce source benchmark titles verbatim.
assumptions: Direct and retrieve-then-compute cloud classifications require deterministic semantic projection of outcome/error, authentication context, selected request parameters, and client family when those values are present in the admitted source record.
Eligibility describes whether the current index can retrieve useful source evidence, not whether vector retrieval alone can prove or calculate the final benchmark answer.

eligibility_definitions.direct_single: One current-index document should contain the semantic action and target needed to retrieve the fact; exact evidence still comes from source hydration.
eligibility_definitions.direct_multi: Several current-index documents directly carry the fact without an additional calculation.
eligibility_definitions.retrieve_then_compute: Current-index documents can retrieve the relevant population, but an exact aggregate, ranking, distinct set, or chronology must be computed outside vector retrieval.
eligibility_definitions.exact_metadata: A current-index document can retrieve the event, but the requested fact is exact, sensitive, or intentionally excluded from dense semantic text and must come from authoritative hydration.
eligibility_definitions.external_enrichment: Telemetry can identify the seed evidence, but the requested conclusion requires an external source.
eligibility_definitions.outside_current_index: The atom is based on telemetry other than a process command line, PowerShell script block, or cloud API action.
eligibility_definitions.needs_review: The benchmark definition does not establish whether the source record contains a current-index observation kind.

atoms.title: Public ACL change event
atoms.rationale: The cloud action is retrievable, while the requested event identity belongs in hydrated metadata rather than dense text.

atoms.title: Exposed storage resource
atoms.rationale: The affected storage resource can be projected as the target of the ACL action.

atoms.title: Direct IAM-user console session authentication
atoms.rationale: A console authentication audit action can project actor kind, authentication context, client, and outcome.

atoms.title: Public principal received read and write grants
atoms.rationale: Grant principals and permissions are semantic request parameters of the ACL action.

atoms.title: AWS Config detected public-access noncompliance
atoms.rationale: This is a configuration-compliance state observation, not a command or cloud API action.

atoms.title: Anonymous warning marker upload
atoms.rationale: An object-store write is a cloud data-plane action with actor status and object target.

atoms.title: Anonymous application-archive overwrite
atoms.rationale: The object overwrite can be represented as a cloud data-plane action with target and size metadata.

atoms.title: Console user terminated running Auto Scaling members
atoms.rationale: The termination API action can project the actor, action, target instances, and requested state transition.

atoms.title: Auto Scaling launched a replacement web instance

atoms.title: New instance entered the web target group

atoms.title: Instance role downloaded the overwritten archive

atoms.title: Apache became available on the new instance

atoms.title: Load balancer first routed a request to the compromised instance

atoms.title: Affected-user endpoint identity
